audience: clinics that run in-person visits and their agenda in ByDoctor

useCases.title: Review the appointments of a week
useCases.text: List the clinic's appointments in a date range, filtered by status, professional or room. Open one to read its times and type.

useCases.title: Sync the appointments changed since a time
useCases.text: List the appointments changed since a given time, oldest update first. Use the cursor links to read the next page.

useCases.title: Look up the rooms, professionals and visit types
useCases.text: List the active rooms, professionals and appointment types of the clinic. Use their ids when you book or move an appointment.

useCases.title: Book an in-person appointment
useCases.text: Book an in-person appointment with a professional and an appointment type, for a patient already in the clinic. Teleconsults are not created by the API.

useCases.title: Move or cancel a scheduled appointment
useCases.text: Change the start time, professional, room or note of an appointment, or cancel it. A confirmed appointment must go back to scheduled first.
